title: Do Not Weary Yourself to Get Rich

questions.question: Do not weary yourself to get rich; be wise enough to does what?
When your eyes light on it, it is gone, for suddenly it sprouts wings, flying like an eagle toward where?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:5 (ESV): "flying like an eagle toward heaven."

questions.question: Do not eat the bread of a man who is stingy; do not desire his delicacies. For he is like one who is inwardly what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:7 (ESV): "For he is like one who is inwardly calculating."

questions.question: Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, for he will despise the good sense of your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:9 (ESV): "for he will despise the good sense of your words."

questions.question: Apply your heart to instruction and your ear to words of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:12 (ESV): "and your ear to words of knowledge."

questions.question: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you strike him with a rod, he will not what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:13 (ESV): "if you strike him with a rod, he will not die."

questions.question: If you strike him with the rod, you will save his soul from what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:14 (ESV): "you will save his soul from Sheol."

questions.question: My son, if not sinners entice you, do not consent. Wait, this is chapter 1. Chapter 23: Let not your heart envy sinners, but continue in the fear of the Lord all the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:17 (ESV): "but continue in the fear of the Lord all the day."

questions.question: Be not among drunkards or among gluttonous eaters of meat, for the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and slumber will clothe them with what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:21 (ESV): "and slumber will clothe them with rags."

questions.question: Buy truth, and do not sell it; buy wisdom, instruction, and what?
Do not move an ancient landmark or enter the fields of the fatherless, for their Redeemer is strong; he will plead their cause against whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:11 (ESV): "he will plead their cause against you."

questions.question: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:26 (ESV): "and let your eyes observe my ways."

questions.question: For a prostitute is a deep pit; an adulteress is a narrow what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:27 (ESV): "an adulteress is a narrow well."

questions.question: She lies in wait like a robber and increases the traitors among whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:28 (ESV): "and increases the traitors among mankind."

questions.question: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has wounds without cause? Those who tarry long over what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 23:29-30 (ESV): "Those who tarry long over wine;"

key_verse_text: Let not your heart envy sinners, but continue in the fear of the Lord all the day.
